sloka: अथ मेघ प्रतीकाशम् कुम्भ कर्ण निवेशनम् ।विभीषणस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महा कपिः ॥५-६-१८॥
transliteration: atha megha pratīkāśam kumbha karṇa niveśanam ।vibhīṣaṇasya ca tathā pupluve sa mahā kapiḥ ॥5-6-18॥

translations.english: Then the great vanara leaped from the residence of Kumbhakarna which looked like a cloud to Vibhishana's.
